note: Cases mirror validate_theme_definition in theme.rs (test_valid_css_color, test_valid_css_length, test_validate_theme_definition) plus the edge values checked against `orb validate --json` on thm-edge-ok, thm-edge-bad, thm-bad and thm-two-orbitals. Findings follow the map order of the program handed to the rule (authored order in these cases); `orb lint` on a file reads maps key-sorted, so within one token map the order can differ from Rust, the set is identical; variants are in name order. ORB_X_UNKNOWN_THEME is not ported (needs the installed theme registry keys). A non-ASCII font name or color word is judged by \p{L}\p{N}, a superset-free approximation of Rust's Unicode \w and is_alphabetic.
